experiment: SG-combined-v1 constrained hierarchical semantic transport and budgeted completion
ca: frozen A3 class-word W: SD1.5, selected eleven CA modules, calls 0-30, all heads, no restored 32x32 CA
sa: SG25/SG33 sources 16/32/64, matched calls 10-20 inclusive, eight heads; head-mean within each call for hierarchy; C0 historical observation-wise fine P2
transport: nonnegative sum-normalized distributions; 2x2 parentwise KL projection with deterministic uniform fallback; no minmax between stages; rho=0.5 only for C5/C9
completion: same-call mean fine SA on normalized completed core; SG32 first-pass selected-row background map; positive residual only; C7 background-only, C8/C9 foreground-background odds
selection: five frozen VOC folds, raw/R2 screens separately, forced OOF and pairwise wins distinct, registered promotion guard, full-VOC thresholds frozen for COCO
sg33_c10: excluded: SG33 had no selected Markov coarse source before SG-combined-v1 submission
storage: resumable per-image confusion counts, compact transport/completion diagnostics, and one post-hoc visual sheet per VOC class; no generated image, mask, dense map, QK or affinity cache
